notes.title: Huge Update on the horizon!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Apologies for the long silence. I have had a lot of things taking my attention like moving house and university. However I have still been working in the background on this project.

I wanted to give you guys a bit of insight about what to expect.

I am going to be launching a huge update within the next month or so which is going to completely overhaul the game.

What can you expect from this update?
- Multiplayer PVP modes
- ALS animation integration
- A new AI system
- New Weapons
- New Customisation system
- Sight cycling
- Inspect animations
- New main menu
- Laser sight
- Mantling
- Metahuman Characters
- Picture in picture sights
- Completely overhauled gunplay mechanics.

I want to thank you for the support while the game has been on a bit of a standstill after the last update but I think the wait will be worth it.

For all the players that currently own the game please join the discord server linked on the store page to verify your ownership and claim 1x free steam key to give to a friend once the update launches.

The game will also go on sale once the update drops for anyone wanting to repurchase the game if you have refunded it.

I am excited to share this new content with you and hear the feedback!

Much love always
-Von

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
Where'd my gun go?

Fixed a bug where new players would have no gun if they did not set it in the weapon customisation screen.

notes.title: Gameplay Patch
notes.content: Completely overhauled the camera with a new gameplay feel

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
Updated HUD
I have listened to the feedback of the objectives pop up being too hard to follow so I have added it as a permanent fixture on the bottom of the HuD

Added ammo boxes
I have added a large ammo cache to both maps behind one of the locked doors to help out a bit

notes.title: Big Fixes Inbound!
notes.content:
Added Zombie Footsteps
Zombies now use a system that detect when their feet touch the ground to emit a footstep
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938038/9076483cf132dec3c922843c4989993c906c1202.gif

Zombie Bodies
You guys asked and I listened. Zombies now stay ragdolled for 10 seconds before the bodies start to disappear. 

Fixing the clothing
Fixed a bug where when there is no save file the meshes for the character customisation goes haywire.

Some UI Updates

All thumbnails have been updated for the character customisation.
This includes all the names and descriptions. 
Removed the character selection button
Disabled text chat for now
Fixed the timer not being synced with the round restart time when the game ends


Added flashlight attachment
The flashlight is now back! This is for all weapons and has been fine tuned.

AK110 Balance Change
Tuned the fire rate for the AK110

notes.title: First of the bug fixes!
notes.content: Fixed the menu bugs and UI while I work on the rest of the bug reports.

notes.title: Thank you for the initial launch support
notes.content:
Well you guys are actually making my dream come true
As a solo dev and a uni student I could never have dreamed of this moment where you guys and girls are buying a game I made on steam. That being said I am not happy with the state of the game and probably never will be. I have had a bunch of oversights and bugs pointed out to me on my discord which has been incredibly helpful. I have a list of things that I am working on to push an emergency hotfix patch today!

What is the roadmap for today's patch?

Footsteps
Bodies
Flashlight
Possibly add the laser
Fixing the clothing
Some UI Updates (Including updating all the customisation thumbnails)
Game restart screen bug fix


This is the minimum I want to get done in this patch. Depending on how much time I have left after doing these I am going to keep pushing to add more content to this patch. I would like to emphasise that for staying completely in the loop about the roadmap of the game and what I am up to please join the discord: https://discord.gg/4gXUXYn2RA

I am dedicated to keep adding content and updates to the game to make it a truly enjoyable indie game and I will need your voice to help me achieve best what you as the community would like to see. There will be no micro transactions and paying the initial price for the game will give you all the content for it. The leveling system is coming to give you a goal to work towards all I ask is a little patience for a solo dev juggling everything on this project. It will get to where you want it to be it will just be a journey.

Much love.
Von <3

notes.title: GET YOUR SWAG ON!
notes.content:
Added New Weapon Menu

New Weapon Customisation menu for a better look and feel. More guns have been added. Weapon skins have been implemented however there is no way to select these at the moment so the applied ones are just a teaser while I get the menu drawn up for it. These skins will be unlocked through the leveling system that will be added in the coming patches. (The AK110 is not usable in the current patch)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938038/725805cf068299184ce5214a791d0e3055322e3c.png

Weapon Mods Now Added to The New Menu
Now there is a tab on the weapons menu that will let you change your attachments. Grips have now been added as well. Procedural animations for holding the guns by the grips are coming soon. Lights will also be added in the coming patch.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938038/0f01e569c7a9b971bf800d65870eb832d43f4da2.png
